transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there! Do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you! My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that helps. One more question: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for your vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. However, if your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass

Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered in turn 7 by advising that "if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further."
